## Replica-layout screen (three instances, seeds 1–3)

Rule fixed before running: a layout is retained if its median improves the TW-LNS median on at least two of the three instances and no instance deteriorates by more than three makespan units.

* **i7, PT-W 8×1** — lcbrtu_3: PT-W 377/381 vs TW-LNS 373/382 (effect +1); lcbrtu_5: PT-W 345/346 vs TW-LNS 344/351.5 (effect +5.5); lcbrtu_8: PT-W 361/362 vs TW-LNS 360/368 (effect +6) — retained.
* **i7, PT-W 4×2** — lcbrtu_3: PT-W 374/376 vs TW-LNS 373/382 (effect +6); lcbrtu_5: PT-W 349/349 vs TW-LNS 344/351.5 (effect +2.5); lcbrtu_8: PT-W 361/364 vs TW-LNS 360/368 (effect +4) — retained.
* **ryzen, PT-W 8×1** — lcbrtu_3: PT-W 372/375 vs TW-LNS 376/381 (effect +6); lcbrtu_5: PT-W 344/344 vs TW-LNS 343/348.5 (effect +4.5); lcbrtu_8: PT-W 360/361 vs TW-LNS 359/369 (effect +8) — retained.
* **ryzen, PT-W 4×2** — lcbrtu_3: PT-W 374/375 vs TW-LNS 376/381 (effect +6); lcbrtu_5: PT-W 345/345 vs TW-LNS 343/348.5 (effect +3.5); lcbrtu_8: PT-W 363/363 vs TW-LNS 359/369 (effect +6) — retained.
